Aman Rosa Alpina reopens on 4 December 2026 in San Cassiano, in the Alta Badia valley of the Italian Dolomites. This is the hotel's second winter season under the Aman name, and it runs until 28 March 2027, according to La Revue des Hôtels on 3 November. Aman's own site confirms the reopening date.

## A family address with a new name

Rosa Alpina dates back to 1939 and the Pizzinini family. After a transformation led by the architect Jean-Michel Gathy, it reopened as Aman Rosa Alpina on 24 July 2025. The hotel keeps a small scale: 51 rooms and suites, from 40 to 158 square metres. The Dolomites Suite, of 100 square metres, has its own outdoor Finnish sauna and a 360-degree view of the peaks.

The location is made for skiing. The hotel stands 300 metres from the Piz Sorega lift, at the heart of the Dolomiti Superski area and its more than 1,200 kilometres of pistes. A ski lounge with a ski butler, a shuttle and private guides complete the offer, and helicopter transfers are available on request from Venice, Bolzano, Innsbruck or Milan.

## What guests find this winter

The Aman Spa covers 1,684 square metres on two levels, with seven treatment rooms. Its 20-metre heated outdoor pool stays open under the snow, alongside an adults-only indoor pool, Finnish and organic saunas, a hammam and a cold pool.

Dining spans Enju, for Japanese shabu-shabu, The Grill for Italian cooking, the Il Salotto lounge bar, the Di Vino Room and the Heritage Room. For cross-country skiers, a five-night winter package for two uses the 26 kilometres of trails at Centro Fondo Alta Badia.

Rates are those of the very top of the Alpine market. La Revue des Hôtels found a Superior Room at €1,641 a night for 6 to 9 December on an advance rate, breakfast included, €1,823 at the standard rate, and €2,208 in mid-January. The Dolomites Suite reaches €6,631 in December and €7,073 in January.

The reopening comes in a busy week for Aman. On 5 November, HOTELS Magazine detailed Amantaru, a resort with branded residences in Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico, and the group's fourth Caribbean destination. The same magazine named Vladislav Doronin, Chairman and CEO of Aman Group, its 2026 Hotelier of the World.

## The signal

Aman Rosa Alpina shows a clear model for the Alps: a short season, few keys and rates set at city-palace level. For Alpine hoteliers, the Dolomites now sit firmly on the same map as Courchevel and St. Moritz for the most demanding winter guests.

We wish the teams in San Cassiano a fine second winter.
summary: Aman Rosa Alpina reopens on 4 December 2026 in San Cassiano for its second winter as an Aman, with 51 rooms and suites, a 1,684 m² spa and a 20-metre heated outdoor pool. The season runs to 28 March 2027.
